metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the standard-library Rust CLI in [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) and [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). It supports ISO 2709 inspection and rendering, MARCXML inspection and rendering, canonical JSON responses, and structured errors. The Cargo `[dependencies]` table is empty.

`cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml` succeeds. I also checked ISO 2709 render/inspect round-tripping with a UTF-8 title and inspected a MARCXML record. Field-level validation is partial: it covers common fields, but does not yet encode the full documentation corpus, so some indicator, subfield, and repeatability rules may be missed.
